description: This file defines the GenericDateDisplayFieldDTO class, which is part of the OrangeHRM reporting module. It encapsulates a DateTime object and provides a method to convert it to a formatted string using a helper trait.

classes.name: GenericDateDisplayFieldDTO
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) that holds a DateTime object and provides formatted string output.
